denominator_or_scope: Observed eligible SKU-days with starts and hours
protocol_note: Continuing episodes have zero new starts. Closed or unobserved days are missing.
Within a SKU-day count overlapping outages once. Maximum 24 hours.
Combine units only for comparable base units. Inspect mix changes.

numerator: Sum of expired units times their actual weighted unit cost
denominator_or_scope: Tracked SKU-days with expiry and cost
protocol_note: Use disposal records. Do not impute cost from procurement quotes.

denominator_or_scope: Opening value plus new tracked receipts in SAR
protocol_note: Count opening value once per window. Missing cost suppresses the metric when coverage is inadequate.

numerator: Counting hours attributed to this SKU
protocol_note: Allocate a shared session's staff time once across observed SKUs. Keep scope constant.

numerator: Count lines differing from physical check
protocol_note: Use the same line-level discrepancy tolerance in both periods.

numerator: Eligible CRUD events with successful scan
protocol_note: Exclude predeclared manual-only lines from both counts.
Count each corrected entry once even when amended more than once.

numerator: Eligible SKU-days with all core fields
denominator_or_scope: Registered SKUs multiplied by local calendar days
protocol_note: Core fields are issued, received, on_hand, stockout_hours, stockout_starts, scan_eligible, scanned.

numerator: Sum of absolute frozen forecast minus actual issues
protocol_note: Archive the forecast before each day begins. Issues can understate demand on stockout days.

numerator: Reviewed alerts with a followed action
protocol_note: Record reason codes for overrides in source records.
